device.name: BLE Fingertip Pulse Oximeter (SP001 / BerryMed)
device.notes:
Uses standard Nordic UART service. Data format for SpO2/PR/PI readings is sent as notifications on UART TX characteristic. Packet size: 20 bytes (MTU-3). Data parsing via chignon package (BroadcastCommand, BroadcastData, DataPacket).
Expected measurements: SpO2%, pulse rate (BPM), perfusion index (%).
Research status: APK acquired, decompiled. Nordic UART service UUIDs recovered. Data frame format TBD — needs HCI snoop. Reference: github.com/jcomas/PulseOximeterSP001 (existing partial implementation).

credentials.notes: No credential of any kind crosses the link. The connection is unauthenticated and unencrypted, so anyone in range can read measurements — a privacy consideration for a medical reading.

factory_reset.effect: Not established. The device stores no credential or binding that a reset would clear, so a reset may not exist at all; no reset command was found in the decompiled app. Power-cycling by removing the batteries is the only state change observed, and whether it clears anything is untested.

methods.description: Connect over GATT and subscribe to notifications on the Nordic UART TX characteristic. No pairing, bonding or app account is involved.

steps.action: Clip the oximeter onto a finger; it powers on and begins advertising.
Scan for the device and connect over GATT.
Subscribe to notifications on the UART TX characteristic.

setup.notes:
There is nothing to provision. The oximeter exposes a Nordic UART service and streams measurements as notifications to whichever client connects; it holds no account, no network credential and no pairing state. Setup is "clip it on and connect".
Confidence is medium rather than high because this has not been run against hardware here — the UUIDs come from a decompiled APK and the data frame format is still TBD.

rejoin.notes: Not applicable in the usual sense — the device joins no network. Any client may connect once the previous one disconnects.

services.notes: Nordic UART service (standard async serial bridge).
